name: Camera rises
verdict: RENDERED 2026-08-04, 3 seeds. Motion 2.065/2.104/2.395 - consistently above the ceiling, so something happens on every seed. WHAT happens is not verified as a rise: on 7701 the strip shows no vertical travel, and the only seed with a vertical displacement signature (7703, dy 285/288) has a correlation peak of 0.022, far too low to read a direction from. Fires, direction unproven. Band 0.406-0.744 (empty control 0.628); frame-scale ceiling 1.191.
